HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Absin.]
Otorrhœa. θ Especially after hemicrania.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Absin.]
Liver feels swollen. θ Autumnal fever.
Pain in spleen ; it feels swollen. θ Autumnal fever.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Absin.]
Horses kick with hind legs toward belly. θ Ascarides.
   

FEVER. [40] [Absin.]
Obstinate autumnal fevers, with swollen liver and spleen.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Absin.]
Paralysis of inner organs.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Absin.]
Especially younger patients. θ Chlorosis.
